_comment: minified-code words its response PER REVIEW MODE, and this is the mode the other fixtures cannot show. An XPI submission is asked for the readable original, or for a source-code submission that reproduces the shipped file. Here that submission already exists - so the ask is about THIS archive: it must hold the readable source a build consumes, not the packed file the build produces. The XPI half of the same check is pinned by inline-script-code and all-checks.
